parent_objective: audit measured source-expanded calibrated scale-up under pre-registered M1714 rules
blocked_by: need result audit before scale-up repair, synthesis, or any controller-family comparison
supersedes: direct branch continuation after M1715 execution

public_gates: M1716 must audit M1715 execution pass/fail plumbing before interpreting task quality
M1716 must compare original_axis_baseline against best_off_track_variant, collision_control_wide_relaxed, and mid_calibration_variant separately
M1716 must apply the pre-registered off-track improvement and collision-delta thresholds
M1716 must classify the result as positive scale-up, conditional positive, tradeoff-only, repair, or runner failure
M1716 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1716 must not claim controller-family ranking, paper-level evidence, or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits source-expanded scale-up task-quality signal after measured execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public diagnostic task-quality audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if required aggregates are missing
stop if all calibrated variants remain off-track dominated above 0.80
stop if no calibrated variant improves off-track rate by at least 0.10
fallback_plan: route to runner repair if M1715 execution failed
route to task-quality repair design if all calibrated variants remain weak
route to branch synthesis if the result is positive or tradeoff-only

admission_evidence: M1715 completed the fixed 864-episode source-expanded scale-up execution
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1716 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up repair or synthesis manifest

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1716 audits task quality and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit must keep profile rows as controls and must not convert them into self-ID claims
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If task-quality calibration fails or is tradeoff-only, record that as scenario-design evidence rather than self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1715 can be audited under the pre-registered M1714 collision/off-track rules to decide whether the source-expanded calibration signal is positive, tradeoff-only, or needs repair.
success_criteria: M1715 result_class and guardrails are audited
original_axis_baseline is used as the baseline variant
all three calibrated variants are compared separately
offtrack_improvement and collision_delta are reported for each calibrated variant
result class is one of positive_scale_up conditional_positive tradeoff_only repair runner_failure
rollout execution training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit omits M1715 execution pass/fail checks
audit chooses a best variant without reporting all calibrated variants
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1716 passes if it audits M1715 under the pre-registered scale-up tradeoff rules and routes to repair, synthesis, or the next paper-route stage without overclaiming.
